description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Pantheon''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|leaps]] to the front of the target enemy's location. If the target is within 800 units upon arrival, he deals physical damage and [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stuns]] them for 1 second. Against minions and monsters, ''Shield Vault'' has a minimum damage of 60 and is capped at 150.

description2.raw: '''[[File:Pantheon Mortal Will.png|20xpx|border|link=Pantheon#Mortal Will|An icon for Pantheon's ability Mortal Will]] [[Pantheon#Mortal Will|Mortal Will]]:''' '''Pantheon''' empowers his next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] within 4 seconds to have a 0.375-second cast time and strike the target 3 times over a brief period, dealing 40% – 55% (based on level) AD physical damage per hit, up to 120% – 170.29% (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] AD. Each hit is affected by [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critical strike]] modifiers and applies [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects.
description2.text: Mortal Will: Pantheon empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have a 0.375-second cast time and strike the target 3 times over a brief period, dealing 40% – 55% (based on level) AD physical damage per hit, up to 120% – 170.29% (based on level)Category:Debug AD. Each hit is affected by critical strike modifiers and applies on-hit effects.

notes.text:
Applies spell damage on the initial vault. Deals basic damage on all the attacks from the empowered ability.
Pantheon will be ordered to basic attack the target at the end of the leap.
The empowered attack rolls a critical strike once for all strikes; either all will critically strike, or none will. If Sundered Sky's Lightshield Strike is ready, all three strikes will critically strike.
Despite the multi-hit attack only having a hidden cast time, Pantheon will remain unable to act until the last strike has been dealt.
* The empowered attack's total time is affected by Pantheon's  attack speed.
* PENDING FOR TEST: The attack's total time is the cast time plus Pantheon's attack windup time.
The 3 strikes that occur after Empowered Shield Vault each count as a separate cast instance for effects such as Electrocute and Eclipse's Ever Rising Moon.
The 3 strikes that occur after Empowered Shield Vault each apply a stack of Mortal Will, even if the attacks are dodged, blocked, or missed while Pantheon is blinded.
The empowered attack will not trigger against structures.
The empowered attack does not cause Pantheon to attack thrice. Effects that trigger on-attack or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with Shield Vault. (e.g. Lethal Tempo, Hail of Blades).
